scope: Strategy-only timing context for durable utility purchases. It compares already-normalized fixed acquisition paths without selecting a path, inferring demand, changing factual eligibility, or treating storage ownership as a route objective by itself.

items.name: Herb sack
items.demand_note: Confirm a current Slayer, Herbiboar, herb-run, or other grimy-herb inventory need before spending shared reward currency.
items.stop_condition: Stop after one confirmed Herb sack purchase; do not keep grinding the source activity without another named reward or progression goal.
items.reentry_condition: Reassess when 58 Herblore and one fixed currency path are ready and grimy-herb inventory pressure is a current account need.

items.name: Seed box
items.demand_note: Confirm current seed-loot or farming-loop inventory pressure before spending Tithe Farm points.
items.stop_condition: Stop after the confirmed Seed box purchase; its six-type storage utility is the target, not open-ended Tithe Farm completion.
items.reentry_condition: Reassess when the fixed Tithe Farm purchase is ready and seed storage will materially support a current loop.

items.name: Coal bag
items.demand_note: Confirm a current Blast Furnace, furnace, Superheat, or other coal-heavy Smithing plan before spending golden nuggets.
items.stop_condition: Stop after buying the Coal bag; Motherlode Mine is a means to the utility target, not a reason to pursue 99 Mining.
items.reentry_condition: Reassess when 100 observed golden nuggets are ready and a named coal-heavy pipeline will use the capacity.

items.name: Gem bag
items.demand_note: Confirm current mining, gem collection, or Crafting inventory pressure before spending golden nuggets.
items.stop_condition: Stop after buying the Gem bag; do not continue Motherlode solely for another storage purchase without a current use.
items.reentry_condition: Reassess when 100 observed golden nuggets are ready and gem storage will improve a named current activity.

items.name: Rune pouch
items.demand_note: Confirm current combat, spellbook, skilling, or transport rune-slot pressure before committing shared points or a high-friction minigame stop.
items.stop_condition: Stop after one confirmed Rune pouch purchase; do not continue an acquisition activity solely because another route also exists.
items.reentry_condition: Reassess when one fixed observed currency path is ready and three-slot rune storage has an immediate account use.
items.unmodeled_path_note: The factual LMS path remains non-executable until member-playtime and shop-row access observations are modeled.
